# nana 研酒所 & Xianyu 咸鱼酒馆 — live music bars in Klang Valley, Malaysia

> Official landing pages for two independent live music bars in Greater Kuala Lumpur: nana 研酒所 in SS13 Subang Jaya and Xianyu 咸鱼酒馆 in Taman Desa, Kuala Lumpur. Both take bookings by WhatsApp; walk-ins are welcome daily.

## nana 研酒所 — SS13 Subang Jaya

- Type: Japanese social live music bar ("dinner first, music later"); Chinese: 梳邦现场音乐酒吧
- Address: 2 Jalan SS 13/3A, Subang Jaya Industrial Estate, 47500 Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12-897 4221
- Hours: 5:00pm–2:00am daily; live music starts around 9:00pm
- Kitchen: dinner from 5pm; late-night ramen 9:30pm–12:30am
- Happy hour: before 8:30pm — beer buckets (5 bottles) buy 1 free 1, Guinness 10 glasses RM175, crispy hand-rolls from RM6.80, pork chop / chicken chop RM16.80
- Food highlights (RM, before 10% service charge and SST): 800g fresh clam (lala) pots RM50–59 (house signature: Maggi curry + parmesan, RM55); crispy hand-rolls RM12–18; hand-wrap rice RM28–35; pasta RM28.80–42.80; chops RM28; bar snacks RM10–25; 3-inch cakes RM28–29
- Drinks highlights: beer buckets RM118–138; signature cocktails RM35–65, most with an alcohol-free version from RM25; Flaming Lamborghini RM128 (RM68 in your birthday month); Choya umeshu from RM228; bottles from RM428 (Roku gin) to RM3,588 (Kweichow Moutai)
- Bottle keeping: spirits 60 days, beer 30 days
- Dietary: non-halal (menu includes pork and alcohol); a lean chicken plate (about 420 kcal) is available all night
- Age policy: under-18 guests must leave by 8:30pm; strictly 18+ after 8:30pm
- Minimum spend: stage sofa RM300, on Fri/Sat/public-holiday-eve nights only; no sofa minimum on weekdays or the public-holiday day itself
- Navigation: search "nana SS13" on Waze or Grab
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/nana.ss13
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/CddBMPbaehJuaard7
- Page: https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/nana/
- [Full menu in text, with prices](https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/nana/#menu-text)
- [Food menu (PDF)](https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/nana/assets/menu/food.pdf)
- [Drinks menu (PDF)](https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/nana/assets/menu/drinks.pdf)

## Xianyu 咸鱼酒馆 — Taman Desa, Kuala Lumpur

- Type: live music bar
- Address: Unit A-G-03, Union Tower, Jalan Desa Bakti, Taman Desa, 58000 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12-652 2885
- Hours: 6:30pm–2:30am daily; live music starts around 9:30pm
- Age policy: strictly 18+ at all hours; no kids
- Minimum spend: sofas on Fri/Sat/public-holiday-eve nights only — RM500 sofa (max 7 guests) or RM1,000 big sofa (max 12 guests); no sofa minimum on weekdays or the public-holiday day itself
- Navigation: search "Xian Yu KL" on Waze or Grab
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/xianyu.kl
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/R8NTbLVmtterrdzh8
- Page: https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/xianyu/
- [Food menu (PDF)](https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/xianyu/assets/menu/food.pdf)
- [Drinks menu (PDF)](https://freddievong.github.io/venue-landings/xianyu/assets/menu/drinks.pdf)

## Notes

- Bookings: WhatsApp with date, time and pax. Confirmations come in English; chat in English or Chinese. No deposit; tables are held about 15 minutes.
- Neither venue allows cigarette smoking indoors; e-cigarettes and vapes are OK.
- Weekly live lineups are posted on each venue's Instagram every Monday.
